//: Gzipped ceilings for every published bundle, in bytes. Read by scripts/check-size.mjs in CI. Raising a number is a deliberate edit with a reason in the commit message, not silent drift. The core ceiling is set so the documented size stays true: it reads '~11kb', which holds from 10752 to 11775 bytes; past that the claim needs rewording, not just a bigger budget. Raised from 9600 (under '~9kb') when error diagnostics landed and crossed that line on its own, then from 10400 to 10600 when four bug fixes together came to 10406, leaving room for the queued devtools plugins view (+132). Raised to 10700 for the core audit fixes (ISSUE-0045 to ISSUE-0050), about 45 bytes across three PRs: v-show showing an element that starts with display: none, v-model leaving an unset field empty, nested v-once, v-bind keeping static class and style, invalid markup selectors reported instead of thrown, and the root $watch stopping on unmount. That left no headroom at 10600. Raised to 10750 for five core audit fixes (ISSUE-0060, ISSUE-0070, ISSUE-0071, ISSUE-0073, ISSUE-0074): regions released when detached or unmounted, v-once keeping v-if, v-for and v-effect static, duplicate v-for keys rebuilding only the earlier row, effects flushed parents first, and a watchEffect stopped when its first run throws; 149 bytes across five PRs, 10738 together. 10750 is the last ceiling under which '~10kb' holds. Raised to 11100, and the documented size reworded from '~10kb' to '~11kb', for the last two core audit fixes (ISSUE-0069, ISSUE-0072): v-model casting numbers as Vue does, re-syncing selects, checkboxes and radios when their options or :value change, and .fill on those controls; an empty v-else-if read as false, v-show keeping a bound display, function expressions called as handlers, .once applied after guards, and $watch comparing with Object.is. About 180 bytes across two PRs, 10917 together with the five before them; each crosses 10751 on its own. 11100 leaves about 1.7% headroom. Headroom is a few percent by design — enough that ordinary work does not trip it, tight enough that a real feature is a conversation.
//plugins: morph raised from 1400 to 1450, and the combined plugins bundle from 4400 to 4450, when morph learned to release scope roots it removes outside every mounted scope (ISSUE-0032): about 40 bytes, and the alternative was leaking effects, listeners and devtools entries. Raised again to 1475 when morph learned to leave alone the attributes a v-bind object binds (ISSUE-0053): 16 bytes, and without it the server's static class, style or any other bound key replaced the bound value on every morph. Raised to 1500, and the combined plugins bundle to 4725, when an unkeyed data-morph-preserve element learned to keep its place (ISSUE-0062): 24 bytes, and without it the element swallowed or was overwritten by the server's node at its position, so navigating with a preserved toast lost the next page's content. navigate raised from 1900 to 2100 when it learned to merge the head (US-0033): 186 bytes, and without it a page-specific stylesheet never loaded after navigating. Raised again to 2250 for the audit fixes (ISSUE-0034): manual scroll restoration, the saved position over the hash, one POST per form at a time, autofocus, and keeping a stylesheet's own onload; 89 bytes. Raised to 2350 for the loading state (US-0034): aria-busy on the document and the submitting form while a navigation is in flight, handed over between overlapping navigations; 84 bytes. Raised to 2600 for opt-in prefetch (US-0034): fetching a link on hover, focus or pointerdown and handing the response to the click; about 210 bytes, and without it every click waits for the full round trip. Raised to 2700 for two audit fixes (ISSUE-0061, ISSUE-0063): a prefetched page used once and unused prefetches aborted, so a double click no longer forced a full load; a link to "#" left to the browser, a redirected POST that cannot render loading where it led, and the scroll position saved as the user scrolls, so forward restores it; about 106 bytes together, and 2600 had 37 spare. popover raised from 1100 to 1150 when v-anchor learned to share a trigger's anchor-name (ISSUE-0035): 27 bytes, and without it a second element anchored to the same trigger lost its anchor. The combined plugins bundle raised from 4450 to 4500 when media capped its raw query subscriptions (ISSUE-0033): 27 bytes, and without it a query built from a changing value kept one MediaQueryList per value for the page's life. Raised to 4550 when v-trap learned to count only what Tab reaches (ISSUE-0038): 73 bytes, and without it a hidden input or a display: none button at the end of a dialog let Tab leave the trap. Raised to 4600 for three plugin fixes (ISSUE-0039, ISSUE-0040, ISSUE-0041): v-collapse hiding collapsed content from Tab and screen readers, v-transition keeping an inline display and removing its classes on teardown, and v-intersect acting on state changes so .leave and .full run when they say; 64 bytes. mask raised from 470 to 500, and the combined plugins bundle to 4700, when v-mask learned to format v-model's initial value and keep the caret in place (ISSUE-0042): 125 bytes standalone and 73 in the combined bundle, and without it a prefilled field showed its raw value and an edit in the middle threw the caret to the end. Raised again to 1175 when v-anchor positioned elements that are not popovers absolutely (ISSUE-0037): 24 bytes, and with position: fixed such an element was misplaced after any layout while its anchor was scrolled away. focus raised from 700 to 775, and the combined plugins bundle from 4725 to 4800, when v-trap learned where Tab really leaves (ISSUE-0065): a radio group counted by its checked radio, the focused container read as before the first, and only the innermost of nested traps handling Tab; 107 bytes standalone and 82 in the combined bundle, and without it Tab left a dialog from a checked radio, from the dialog itself, or between nested traps. The combined figure also covers media waking its readers on unmount (ISSUE-0064), 4 bytes. mask raised from 500 to 525, and the combined plugins bundle to 4850, when v-mask learned to keep the caret past a leading literal (ISSUE-0066): 18 bytes standalone and 19 in the combined bundle, and without it deleting the first digit of (999) 999-9999 put the caret before the "(". The combined figure also covers the v-trap (ISSUE-0065, 82 bytes) and media (ISSUE-0064, 4) fixes, about 4815 together. Raised to 4900 for the 2026-11-10 audit fixes, about 4881 together: morph keeping a v-teleport element (ISSUE-0110), 41 bytes in the combined bundle; v-transition, v-focus and v-collapse acting only when their state changes, and a same-flush v-if leave removing its element (ISSUE-0098, ISSUE-0099), 4; and v-persist saving nowhere for an unknown storage (ISSUE-0101), 1. morph raised to 1550 for the same v-teleport fix: 35 bytes, and without it a keyed teleported element was duplicated by a morph, and one teleported out of a shared region was lost after a navigation. navigate raised to 2750 for two audit fixes (ISSUE-0111, ISSUE-0112): data islands such as type="application/json" kept when a fetched page renders, and an in-flight navigation stopped when the app unmounts; 35 bytes, and without them code reading a data island saw it vanish after a navigation, and a navigation waiting on a stylesheet rendered into an unmounted app. popover raised to 1200 when v-popover learned to wait until its element is in the document (ISSUE-0100): 37 bytes, and without it a popover rendered by v-if or v-for while its state was already true never opened.
//devtools: The devtools ceiling is looser than the others on purpose. This bundle is development-only and never loads in production, so its bytes cost a visitor nothing — and the panel's usability is the entire reason it exists. Raised from 5600 to 6000 when docking landed, from 6000 to 6500 when state search and a collapsible scope tree landed, from 6500 to 6800 for per-mode resize handles, and from 6800 to 7200 for the plugins view, to leave room for the panel to keep improving rather than making every UI change a budget negotiation.
